title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nila gets angry over Chozhan's playful teasing and responds with cute mischief. Vannathi questions Pandian about the two-wheeler he bought for her, causing tension.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Devika surprises Manoj by promising property in his name and arranging his wedding night with Kanaga. Later, Kanaga troubles him by fearing the dark and insisting he play with her.

title: Cooku With Comali
description: The show opens with a surprise as Comalis choose their cooks while they perform entertaining get-up roles. The fun continues as they pick ingredients using their cooks' clues.
